The patient started Metformin 500 mg via oral route.
Later, the patient developed nausea.
The doctor prescribed Amoxicillin 250 mg for infection.
After two days, skin rash appeared.
The patient began treatment with Lisinopril.
Soon after, the patient experienced persistent cough.
Ibuprofen was administered for pain relief.
Subsequently, the patient developed gastric irritation.
The patient was treated with Ibuprofen and Paracetamol.
Later, stomach irritation developed.
